LABUAN COMPANIES ACT 1990

LABUAN COMPANIES (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 146(1) of the

Labuan Companies Act 1990 [Act 441], the Minister, on the recommendation of the

Authority, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Labuan Companies (Amendment)

Regulations 2026.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 July 2026.

Substitution of Third Schedule
